basic_info.description: 3090 San Bruno Ave is a nice and well maintained 4 unit building that was built on a corner lot in 1990. It is a great investment opportunity in the city's San Bruno Ave in the Portola district. This could be an investment or/and owner move-in property.    This building is consist of 4 units; Unit #A has 3bed/2bath($4,200/month), Unit #B has 3bed/2bath (section 8 tenant $4,438/month), Unit #C is 3bed/2bath(currently vacant, previous tenant paid $4,300/month), Unit #D is 2bed/1bath (currently vacant, previous tenant paid $2,600/month). The lower floor has 2 cars garage with plenty of storage. A large and spacious backyard with concrete patio and landscaping areas offers for the enjoyment of  owner or tenants. Each unit are separately metered with PG&E and water meters for their own usages. Each unit has a very functional floor plan with generously sized that includes higher ceilings, living room, a dining room. A,B,C unit has Private laundry room a fireplace.  Shopping and public transit is a breeze. Investors and 1031 Exchanges are welcome!
